notes.title: Multiplayer, Jungle & more coming soon! (Developer update)
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.albe.pw/rvMSw.gif[/img]

Within the next few weeks a lot more big features are being added to the game!
I am currently developing quite a few new features, some of them being;

[list]
    [*][b]Multiplayer[/b]
    [*]3 multiplayer gamemodes
    [*][b]New environment![/b] Jungle.
    [*]Trading cards
[/list]

These features will be added within the next few weeks as a normal update to the game - no DLC's or anything.

This update is quite big and has taken a [i]long[/i] time and now that it's finally close to release. I am looking forward to play the game [i]with[/i] you!


If you've got any suggestions, questions or anything really, feel free to ask in the comments!

notes.title: The Checkpoint update (yayy new features + achievements!)
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.albe.pw/xLsbx.PNG[/img]


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Checkpoints![/b]
- Every once in a while, a Golden Chain will spawn. If you grab it a checkpoint with [b]1[/b] life will spawn [i](Meaning you can respawn at the checkpoint [u]once[/u] before it's game over)[/i]
    [*][b]2 new achievements![/b]
    [*][b]Improved UI[/b]
- Settings are now [i]way[/i] more cool-looking, and with a couple of new features too like "[i]Replay Tutorial[/i]" and "[i]Credits[/i]".
[/list]

More chains will also spawn, so you should never have to wait for new ones! The chains also got a nice makeover, and are now wayyy more shiny and beautiful.

[h1][b]Soon to come[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]A couple of new obstacles [i](like clothing lines)[/i]
    [*]Multiple [b]Gamemodes![/b]
- like [i]Zero Gravity[/i] and [i]rusty-only![/i]
    [*]More environments
    [*]Multiplayer
[/list]

Feedback is very welcome anywhere - reviews, the [i]discussion[/i] section or here!

notes.title: Achievements, Easter Eggs & Rick Astley
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.albe.pw/9pUcd.PNG[/img]

Hey there - just a small update here!
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
    [*]Two new [i]secret[/i] achievements
    [*]Easter-eggs!
    [*]Made the start-zone (prison) better in general
    [*]New obstacle - you'll know it when you see it!
[/list]

Thanks a lot for checking by. There will be a few more of these minor-content additions the next couple of days, and then some major ones later on next week! Multiplayer is coming very soon with two game-modes: [i]Capture The Flag[/i] and [i]Last Man Standing[/i] - so look forward to that happening in a couple of weeks!

We are also currently working on [b]multiple environments[/b] so you don't have to look at the same ol' town over and over [i](even though it's randomly generated)[/i] - with this, we'll also add turns in the road, and new obstacles along the way!

Thanks for the support so far - please don't hesitate to suggest features or ask questions in the Discussion section.
Happy swinging!
